author: Unknown Studios
description: A real-time PvP mobile strategy game combining Ataxx/Hexxagon-style hexagonal territorial domination with asymmetrical deck-building and troop deployment, set in a sci-fi universe of sentient alien slimes.
name: goo-galaxy

scripts.check: npm run check:csharpier && npm run check:editorconfig && npm run check:prettier
scripts.check:csharpier: dotnet csharpier check Assets/Scripts Assets/Playtest Assets/Editor --ignore-path .formatterignore
scripts.format: npm run format:csharpier && npm run format:prettier
scripts.format:csharpier: dotnet csharpier format Assets/Scripts Assets/Playtest Assets/Editor --ignore-path .formatterignore
